conventions.modelOrigin: Poly Haven pivots: base at y=0, roughly centred in X/Z (exact extents in bboxMin/bboxMax).
conventions.normalMaps: OpenGL convention (+Y up; Poly Haven nor_gl / ambientCG NormalGL) - matches three.js defaults, no normalScale flip needed.
conventions.roughAo: rough.jpg and ao.jpg are separate single-channel grayscale JPGs (no packed ARM). three.js reads roughness from G and AO from R - grayscale works for both.
conventions.tiling: Use RepeatWrapping; repeat = surfaceSizeMeters / realWorldSizeMeters. ambientCG sizes are unknown unless listed; suggestedSizeMetersEstimate is an eyeballed estimate.
conventions.gltf: GLBs use EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization + EXT_texture_webp (1024 px). The loader needs MeshoptDecoder (drei useGLTF enables it by default). No Draco.

zawiszy_czarnego.name: Zawiszy Czarnego
zawiszy_czarnego.notes: Bright partly-cloudy afternoon in Klodzko (Poland): street with mature trees and a pre-war brick/plaster building, lots of sky. Soft low-contrast light (peak luminance ~39, no hard sun) - add a DirectionalLight if sun patches are wanted. Use the .hdr for scene.environment (PMREM) and the _bg.jpg (EquirectangularReflectionMapping, SRGBColorSpace) as the visible window view.
zawiszy_czarnego.author: Grzegorz Wronkowski

golden_bay.name: Golden Bay
golden_bay.notes: Blue-hour waterfront in Rostock (Germany): modern residential blocks with lit windows, warm street lamps, deep blue sky. Lamp hotspots are extremely bright (peak ~25000) - use a lowish environmentIntensity and/or rely on interior lights. The Poly Haven tonemapped background is brighter than a real dusk exposure; lower backgroundIntensity (~0.4-0.7) for an evening mood.
golden_bay.author: Greg Zaal
